title: Greentalmod
description: Changes PortalMod's Antline to Green(active) and Magenta(inactive)
body:
![Logo](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/2f30341dee8323b2bc921acaa0b99ad6d769a8b2.png)

A texturepack that changes PortalMod's antlines to green.


![Greenline](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b80c29136ebc16f7bd5c81b639c48efaba349252.png)

Every item texture is changed, but keeps the original shape and colors except the indicator part. 
![Greenton](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/85ff93c9beb8f4b457bcc2b622757ebb25f3e11d.png)

The block's textures are also changed (duh) and also keep the original shape and colors.
